# Jerry Moran Watchdog File

Subject: Jerry Moran, Republican, KS
Current office: U.S. Senate KS
Compiled: 2026-10-23 for the On Point Politics watchdog database, onpointpolitics.us
Status: queued for hand research, priority 2. This file holds the roster facts, the office levers, and FEC pipeline data when the pipeline has run. It is not yet a finished Tier 2 profile.

## Race

Not on the 2026 ballot. delegation member not running
Roster note: seat up 2028

## Committee assignments

- Senate Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry
- Senate Committee on Appropriations
- Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation
- Senate Committee on Indian Affairs
- Senate Committee on Veterans' Affairs (Chairman)
- Senate Select Committee on Intelligence

## Money

Not yet pulled. Run pipeline/fec_pull.py for federal subjects. Governors and other state candidates need hand research in the state campaign finance system.

## Levers this office controls

Template rows from the office and committee assignments. Each needs the specific decision, the date, and the subject position before it counts as a finding.

| Decision | Where it sits | Which blocs care |
|---|---|---|
| Confirmation votes for cabinet, judges, regulators and ambassadors | U.S. Senate | Every bloc with a regulator; Wall Street and banking; Crypto and finance; Health care and pharma |
| Filibuster and cloture votes on major legislation | U.S. Senate | Party and leadership |
| Farm bill, sugar program, crop insurance, CFTC jurisdiction over prediction markets and crypto commodities | Senate Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry | Sugar and agriculture; Crypto and finance; Gambling |
| Annual spending bills and earmarks, including detention funding and defense procurement | Senate Committee on Appropriations | Defense contractors; Detention vendors; Developers and construction; Health care and pharma |
| AI preemption, spectrum, aviation, transportation safety, consumer protection, FTC and FCC nominations | Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation | AI industry; Tech; Crypto and finance |
| Tribal gaming, Indian Gaming Regulatory Act, tribal lands | Senate Committee on Indian Affairs | Gambling |
| VA health care contracts and community care | Senate Committee on Veterans' Affairs (Chairman) | Health care and pharma |
| Intelligence authorization, surveillance authorities, classified contracts | Senate Select Committee on Intelligence | Defense contractors; Tech |
